title: Naruto
source: Naruto manga by Masashi Kishimoto (700 chapters), up to the chapter 700 epilogue. Boruto is not used.
world: A world of hidden ninja villages in the Five Great Nations, each led by a Kage. The story follows Naruto Uzumaki of the Hidden Leaf Village from outcast to Hokage, through rivalries, the criminal group Akatsuki and the Fourth Great Ninja War. It mixes training-and-friendship shonen energy with cycles of hatred, war and sacrifice. The epilogue shows a peaceful era with Naruto as the Seventh Hokage.
power_system: Ninja mould chakra (body + spirit energy) into techniques (jutsu) with hand signs: ninjutsu, genjutsu and taijutsu. Kekkei genkai are inherited abilities, such as the Uchiha Sharingan (and Mangekyo Sharingan), the Hyuga Byakugan and the Rinnegan. Nine tailed beasts (Bijuu) are sealed inside people called jinchuriki; Naruto holds the Nine-Tails, Kurama.

timeline.summary: Naruto becomes a genin, joins Team 7, the Chunin Exams, Orochimaru attacks the Leaf, the Third Hokage dies, Sasuke leaves for Orochimaru.
Naruto returns after training with Jiraiya; Akatsuki captures Gaara; Asuma dies, Shikamaru avenges him.
Jiraiya dies fighting Pain; Sasuke kills Itachi and learns the truth about the Uchiha.
Pain destroys the Leaf; Naruto defeats him in Sage Mode; Nagato revives the villagers and dies.
Tobi declares the Fourth Great Ninja War.
Reanimated Itachi stops Edo Tensei; Obito is unmasked; Madara returns; Kaguya appears; Naruto and Sasuke seal her.
Naruto and Sasuke fight at the Valley of the End; each loses an arm; they make peace.
Naruto is the Seventh Hokage, married to Hinata with Boruto and Himawari; Sasuke wanders, married to Sakura with Sarada.
